methods: # Reproducibility — WAIKE Research Ops Education/ops content plus Python validators. This repo does not produce RF results. ```bash git clone https://github.com/gunnchOS3k/waike-research-ops.git cd waike-research-ops python3 -m pip install pytest PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_pathway_schema.py tests/journeys tests/curriculum/test_digital_rc_batch.py ``` Expected: pytest PASS. Digital-RC count is **14 packages discovered from** `curriculum/digital_rc/*/course.json` — do not report 18 as COURSE_DIGITAL_RC. Optional full lab bundle (heavier): ```bash PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/emit_digital_rc.py PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/run_course_labs.py ``` ## Tool versions | Tool |
